## Peace Vigil with Wind in the Spirit

**Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 6:00 PM**

Please join us for another Peace Vigil, held together with our friends from Wind in the Spirit. We will gather in front of the meeting house. Please dress warmly.

## Christmas Breakfast and Worship

**Sunday, December 20, 2026**

Please join us for our Christmas Breakfast at **9:30 AM**, followed by worship at **10:30 AM**, at the meeting house. You are encouraged to bring some baked goods to share.

## Location

[225 Watchung Ave Plainfield, NJ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VutTE3G3TwLKkwvp9)

All are welcome at both events. Feel free to bring a friend!
